final: WITH color_amounts AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), benchmarks AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_per_color, SUM(invoiced_amount) AS total_invoiced FROM color_amounts) SELECT AVG(c.invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(1.0 * c.invoiced_amount / b.total_invoiced) AS average_share, AVG(c.invoiced_amount - b.average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average FROM color_amounts AS c CROSS JOIN benchmarks AS b WHERE c.invoiced_amount > b.average_per_color
